findings.object: white_pot (frame-0 anchor; the error spreads to the whole scene, and the spoon takes most of it)
findings.frames: f0 anchor; the same error is measured at f0-24 and f272-287, so it is present over the whole track
findings.observation: The FoundationStereo depth shows the real table tilted 5.48 deg in the loader world (ascent azimuth 78 deg) and the floor, 62 cm below it, tilted 6.08 deg. The two planes are parallel to within 1.07 deg and the floor is flat (residual within +-0.4 cm over 1.0-3.4 m). This means the GeoCalib gravity that sets the world z is off by about 5.5-6 deg. The reference pot is level in that wrong world (rim plane within 0.9 deg at f0 and 0.6 deg at f280), so relative to the real pot it is tilted about 6 deg and sits 1.4-1.7 cm too low. The spoon agrees with the depth: it lies on the depth table. Because the scorer aligns the whole scene to the pot's frame-0 pose, the pot's 6 deg error rotates every other trajectory about the pot.
findings.evidence: Depth table vs the sim plane (C:\v2d_demo\diag\ep5_objA\run_dt5.out, ep5_depthtab.png): the pot bottom is +0.21 cm above the sim plane but -1.51 cm below the depth table. On pot pixels, real depth minus mesh depth has median -0.75 cm (p25 -2.02). The spoon bottom is +0.21 cm above the depth table at the start and -0.06 at the end. Floor, table and ICP results are in run_dt5b.out and ep5_depthB.json. Point-to-plane ICP of the masked depth onto the pot mesh: at f0-24 it asks for a 5.98 deg rotation about [0.87,-0.39,-0.31] plus a 1.69 cm lift, and the median residual drops from 6.1 to 1.8 mm. After this correction the pot bottom is at z 1.0137, against the depth table at 1.0151; the table was not used in the fit. At f272-287 the correction is 6.15 deg and +1.36 cm, with the residual dropping from 5.7 to 1.6 mm. The spoon's long axis rises 3.8 deg, close to the depth-table slope along it (5.1 deg), and both spoon ends are 0.6-0.7 cm above the depth table. GeoCalib (ken_c_scored/episode_000005/white_pot/geocalib/gravity.json) gives roll 5.04 / pitch -40.4 deg at frame 0 with a focal length of 1022-1038, against the calibrated 1149.8 in intrinsics_stable.json. Its 8 samples spread by about 2.4 deg. The camera heading is azimuth 88 deg, so the error is mostly in pitch. bob1 has the identical gravity_alignment_transform, so it has the same issue. ep1 (4.5-5.1 deg, ~/v2d_ops/kenc/depthtab/ep1/ep1_depthtab.json) and ep8 (4.3 deg; pot -1.2 to -1.6 cm below the depth table; ~/v2d_ops/kenc/depthtab/ep8/dt8.log) show the same pattern. Impact model (C:\v2d_demo\diag\ep5_objA\anchor_impact.json): taking the ICP correction as the truth and applying the scorer's pot-f0 alignment, the s42@95M spoon AUC falls from 0.869 to 0.718 (start ICP) or 0.770 (end ICP) and the pot from 0.903 to 0.896-0.898. The episode falls from 0.886 to 0.807-0.834. The spoon's mean ADD rises from 1.94 to 3.26 cm, and is 2.56 cm at f0 alone. The s43@90M seed gives the same picture.
findings.confidence: medium (four independent depth checks agree; the impact model assumes the pot carries a constant body-frame error and the spoon track is right)
fix_options: Estimate gravity from the stereo-depth table plane instead of GeoCalib: run RANSAC on the table pixels around the f0 object masks (frames 0-24, hands and objects excluded). Accept it only if the floor plane agrees within 2 deg (here 1.07 deg). Then rotate the bundle world (camera, objects, hands) so the table normal is +z. This is an automatic, GT-free rule that applies to every episode.

Re-anchor the pot's f0 pose to the full stereo depth, either with trimmed point-to-plane ICP (code in C:\v2d_demo\diag\ep5_objA\dt5b.py) or with FoundationPose full-depth registration (reanchor.sh). Gate: the residual must at least halve and the corrected bottom must rest on the depth table within 3 mm. Carry the correction through the whole pot track as a constant body-frame offset (start and end corrections agree: 5.98 vs 6.15 deg, same axis), or re-track from the new anchor. Do this together with the gravity fix; otherwise the sim would tip the corrected pot back to level.
Rebuild the supports after both changes. The table then sits at the depth height under both objects and the spoon needs no disk, which also removes ep5A-2.

Sanity gate before training: the SAM 3 silhouette IoU at f0-24 must be at least as good with the corrected pot. Check other pot-anchored episodes (ep1, ep8) with the same depth test; the loss may be systematic.
